assignments.name: businessInfo
assignments.value:
Opening hours: Mon-Fri 8am-7pm, Sat 9am-1pm.
Services: physiotherapy assessment (45 min), follow-up treatment (30 min), sports massage, post-surgery rehab.
New patients: first assessment includes a treatment plan.
Parking: free on-site.
Insurance: we accept most major health insurers; bring your policy number.

assignments.name: emergencyAdvice
assignments.value: your local emergency number (999 in the UK, 911 in the US) or go to the nearest emergency department

nodes.name: Settings
nodes.notes: EDIT ME: your business details, emails, AI provider and Google Sheet. Nothing else needs changing.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: $json.valid, message: $json.valid ? 'Thanks! We will be in touch shortly.' : 'Please check your email address and message.' }) }}

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ model: $('Settings').item.json.llmModel, temperature: 0.2, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: "You are the front-desk assistant for " + $('Settings').item.json.businessName + ", a " + $('Settings').item.json.businessType + ". Read a website enquiry and return ONLY a JSON object with these keys: category (one of: booking, question, pricing, complaint, urgent, spam, other), urgent (true if the person describes severe pain, an injury that just happened, chest pain, breathing difficulty, heavy bleeding, or anything that sounds like an emergency; otherwise false), summary (one sentence for staff), reply (a warm, short email reply, max 110 words, signed '" + $('Settings').item.json.signature + "'). Rules for the reply: use ONLY the facts in BUSINESS INFO; never diagnose or give medical advice; never promise prices, availability or outcomes that are not in BUSINESS INFO; if urgent, tell them to call " + $('Settings').item.json.emergencyAdvice + " and do not try to help further; for bookings, share the booking link; if you don't know, say a team member will reply within " + $('Settings').item.json.responseTime + ". Write in the same language as the enquiry. For spam, reply with an empty string.

BUSINESS INFO:
" + $('Settings').item.json.businessInfo + "
Booking link: " + $('Settings').item.json.bookingLink + "" }, { role: 'user', content: 'Name: ' + $json.name + '
Email: ' + $json.email + '
Phone: ' + $json.phone + '
Message: ' + $json.message }] }) }}

nodes.name: AI Triage & Draft
nodes.notes: Any OpenAI-compatible API works (Groq free tier, OpenAI, OpenRouter, a local Ollama at http://localhost:11434/v1). Credential: Header Auth, name 'Authorization', value 'Bearer YOUR_KEY'.
